description: This file contains a benchmark implementation for TopK algorithms using the BenchmarkDotNet framework, focusing on frequency counting and sampling techniques within the Orleans project. It defines classes for data structures, sampling algorithms, and benchmarking methods specifically related to TopK processing.

classes.name: EdgeClass
classes.description: A record class wrapping an Edge, used within the benchmark to represent edge data.

classes.name: EdgeCounter
classes.description: A class representing a counter for an Edge, tracking its frequency in the sampling process.

classes.name: EdgeFrequentItemCollection
classes.description: A specialized collection maintaining frequent edges with a specified capacity.

classes.name: EdgeClassFrequentItemCollection
classes.description: A collection similar to EdgeFrequentItemCollection but for EdgeClass items.

classes.name: UlongFrequentItemCollection
classes.description: A collection maintaining frequent ulong items, implementing key-based operations for the frequent items.

classes.name: FrequencySink
classes.description: An implementation of the Space-Saving algorithm for counting top-k frequency elements over data streams, with internal heap management.

classes.name: ZipfRejectionSampler
classes.description: A class implementing rejection sampling for the Zipf distribution, used to generate skewed samples efficiently.

methods.name: GlobalSetup
methods.description: Initializes the sampling and graph data structures before benchmarking iterations.

methods.name: IterationSetup
methods.description: Prepares the state before each benchmarking iteration, optionally clearing collections.

methods.name: FssAdd
methods.description: Adds each edge sample to the EdgeFrequentItemCollection, benchmarking this operation.

methods.name: SinkAdd
methods.description: Adds each edge sample to the FrequencySink, benchmarking the space-saving frequency counting.

methods.name: Sample
methods.description: Generates a sample following the Zipf distribution used for weighted sampling.
